## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Huì xuán jì* in 40 fascicles is the great Yuán-period synthesis-commentary by [普瑞](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E7%91%9E) Pǔruì on the *xuán tán* (玄談 — preliminary doctrinal essays) sections of [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān's *[Shū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0011)* and *[Chāo](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0012)*. At 40 fascicles, this is the largest single Yuán Buddhist commentarial work on a Tang Buddhist text, drawing together the entire Sòng-period commentary tradition on Chéngguān's *xuán tán* into a unified doctrinal apparatus.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1300 – 1368) reflects the Yuán dynasty period during which the work was composed. The 40-fascicle scope makes the *Huì xuán jì* one of the most ambitious Buddhist commentarial projects of the Yuán dynasty, comparable in scope to the parallel Sòng *huì běn* projects (*[Shū-Chāo huì běn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0021)*, *[Hé lùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0066)*). Its consolidation of the Sòng commentary tradition makes it an essential reference for understanding the late-imperial Chinese Huáyán-school doctrinal landscape.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X236) collection.
